upstream_protocol: The unmodified entrypoint trains the paper's county-level COVID benchmark for up to 50,000 steps and writes only upstream MAE/NLPD output.

attempts.device: CPU because the author-pinned TensorFlow 2.4.1 cannot load the CUDA 11 runtime on this host
attempts.outcome: Stopped after the unmodified process remained in its 50,000-step upstream training loop. It cannot produce a 52-jurisdiction Setting B result and would otherwise occupy the local baseline host for many additional hours.

The unmodified source loaded the bundled COVID data and entered LMC construction, then TensorFlow 2.16.2 failed before training with CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE because its PTX path is incompatible with compute capability 12.0.

The unmodified source loaded the bundled COVID data, then failed before the first optimization step because ind_times_covid.pkl has shape (50, 1) while the script passes it to lax.dynamic_slice as a one-dimensional array: ValueError: Length of slice indices must match number of operand dimensions (1 vs (50, 1)).

setting_b_interpretation: LMC-SVGP, IMC-SVGP and FSDE-SVI table rows are completed causal adapters that call pinned upstream constructors, trainers and predictive covariance code. They are not presented as scores from an upstream county-level entrypoint.
